preconditions.description: Number of graph variants is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each variant: 1 <= n <= 500000 and 0 <= m <= 500000
preconditions.description: Each graph variant has between 1 and 500,000 vertices and between 0 and 500,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: for each edge: 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices.

preconditions.expression: sum(n) over all variants <= 500000 and sum(m) over all variants <= 500000
preconditions.description: Total number of vertices and edges across all variants does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.expression: for each variant: output is either 'No' or 'Yes' followed by a valid set of vertices
postconditions.description: For each graph variant, the output indicates whether a valid set of vertices can be stolen.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes': 1 < c < n and c distinct integers representing vertices
postconditions.description: If a valid set of vertices can be stolen, the output includes the number of vertices stolen and their indices.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'No': no additional information is provided
postconditions.description: If no valid set of vertices can be stolen, the output is simply 'No'.
